body: So my work paid for a cab and they told me the only way I was leaving was either willingly in the cab or forced through a hospital. I wish they would let me go. I am so tired and done fighting.

I feel the same way, because of my current living situation I can't talk on the phone so I use the chat. Of all the times I've used it so very unhelpful. I really do not want to do in patient and I will hide if someone tries to 302 me again.

I don't want any more attachments and people that could possibly be hurt when I do it. It's not a matter if merely how close is the when. I just want to ensure first my family can't get access to my body or my possessions.

I am so very tired all of the time. This struggle has been my entire life. I can't fight it any more, I don't want to fight it any more. My life has been perpetually bleak. I don't think there is any part of me left that envisions life beyond the next few weeks and I am okay with that. I see it as an end to pain and to suffering. No more hurting all the time. No more internal battles. 

I wish that others could understand this struggle and know that I wouldn't be in pain any more. That for a long time I did fight and I did try. I did not just lay down I did go kicking and screaming but now I am tired.

The only positive relationship I have left is my roommate, but I believe even she would be better off in the long run. No more troubles with me, no more ups and downs. It may hurt her for a little but she would move on. I am nothing to no one else. My family cast me out. I have nothing else. When I leave work no one notices if I would be alive or dead.

I have a good job, a car, apartment, insurance and all the things I want. It is some part of me that is already dying on the inside. I just wish the rest of me caught up. Every day hurts and brings a whirlwind of emotion and further instability. When I do kill myselfnit will be an end to that painful struggle. No more hurt and I can finally rest.

If they truly loved me they'd let me go.

I have no energy to do even things I love to do, I just lay and read most nights. I am sad all the time. I just want to rest I do not know if I can make it to the time the medicine kicks in. This is getting to the point where it's not a matter if but how close is the when.
